title: Copilot
description: Try the chat assistant end to end. Type as the customer: in Copilot mode you get grounded drafts to review, in Autopilot the bot answers on its own from public documents.

noWorkspaces.title: No workspace to test
noWorkspaces.body: Create an active workspace with a knowledge base first.

controls.copilotHint: Copilot: an operator is in the chat. The assistant never writes to the customer, it prepares drafts with sources for you to insert, edit or ignore.
controls.autopilotHint: Autopilot: the bot replies by itself, only from public documents. When it is not sure it refuses and hands the chat to a person, using no model tokens.

thread.title: Conversation
thread.emptyCopilot: Pick a starter below or type a question. Drafts for the operator appear on the right.
thread.emptyAutopilot: Pick a starter below or type a question. The bot answers in this thread.
thread.offTopic: Off-topic messages: {{count}}. A reminder after {{warn}}, the chat ends after {{cutoff}}.
thread.ended: The assistant ended this conversation. Start a new one to continue.

starters.title: Try asking
starters.refuseHint: The assistant should refuse: the answer is internal or not offered.
starters.handoffHint: A commitment: the assistant should hand over to a person.

voice.transcribed: Transcript ready. Review it and send.
voice.micFallback: No microphone available here, so a sample take is recorded.
voice.noVoice: No voice is available for this language.

disclosure.first: The first reply carries a notice that it comes from an automated assistant.
disclosure.always: Every reply carries a notice that it comes from an automated assistant.

panel.title: Assistant panel
panel.emptyCopilot: Send a customer message to see the stages, sources and drafts.
panel.emptyAutopilot: Send a customer message to see how the bot decides.
panel.error: The assistant could not finish this turn.

grounding.title: Grounding
grounding.noModel: No model call was made for this turn.

tier1.title: Knowledge passages
tier1.hint: Found by search alone, without calling a model.

reason.low_score: The knowledge base has no reliable answer.
reason.commitment: The customer asks for a commitment only a person can make.
reason.risky: The message is sensitive or asks for internal information.
reason.off_topic: The conversation left the service topic.
reason.requested: The customer asked for a person.

blocked.title: Autopilot is not answering
blocked.off: Autopilot is switched off for this workspace.
blocked.no_public_docs: There are no public documents, so there is nothing the bot may quote.
blocked.killed: The platform kill switch has stopped the bot.
blocked.missing_scope: The business scope is empty, so the bot cannot tell what is on topic.

citation.description: The passage this statement is grounded in.

bot.title: Bot
bot.description: How the assistant speaks, what it may answer and when it hands over. Settings you do not change are inherited from the platform default.
bot.readOnly: Members can read these settings. An owner can change them.
bot.saveError: Could not save the bot settings.

kill.globalBody: The platform kill switch is on. Autopilot does not answer in any workspace until an operator resumes it.
kill.tenantTitle: The bot is stopped for this workspace
kill.tenantBody: An operator stopped the bot here. Settings can still be edited, but Autopilot will not answer.

autopilot.title: Autopilot
autopilot.description: Let the bot answer customers on its own, using public documents only.
autopilot.switchHint_one: {{count}} public document is available to quote.
autopilot.switchHint_other: {{count}} public documents are available to quote.
autopilot.noDocsBody: Mark at least one knowledge-base document as public before turning Autopilot on.

persona.title: Persona and languages
persona.description: The voice of the assistant and the languages it may reply in.
persona.label: Persona
persona.hint: How the assistant introduces itself and the tone it keeps. {{count}} / 800

languages.label: Reply languages
languages.hint: Keep at least one. Customers writing in another language get the first one.

copy.title: Messages
copy.description: Fixed wording per language. The assistant uses it instead of improvising.
copy.refusalHint: Shown when the knowledge base has no reliable answer or the question is out of bounds.
copy.handoffHint: Told to the customer when the chat goes to a person.

canned.title: Quick answers
canned.description: If a message contains the trigger, this exact reply is sent without any model call.

grounding.title: Answer quality
grounding.description: How sure the assistant must be before it answers from the knowledge base.
grounding.minScoreHint: Passages scoring below this are never used. Higher means safer and more refusals.
grounding.minHitsHint: How many passages must clear the score before it answers.
grounding.topKHint: How many top passages are read.
grounding.maxCharsHint: Characters. Longer replies are trimmed at a sentence.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: What the assistant may talk about.

kb_only.name: Knowledge base only
kb_only.body: Answers only from public documents. Anything else is refused.

general.name: Plus general help
general.body: May add general, harmless context around the documents.

open.name: Open
open.body: Answers any topic. Not recommended for customer chat.

scope.businessHint: A plain description of what is on topic. Required for Autopilot.
scope.offTopicHint: What the bot does when a message is outside the scope.
scope.cutoffAfterHint: Off-topic messages before the chat is closed.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.description: People are available in these hours ({{tz}}). Outside them a hand-over says so.

handoff.title: Hand-over and disclosure
handoff.description: When a person takes over and how the bot identifies itself.
handoff.summary: Write a summary for the person
handoff.summaryHint: A short brief of the chat so far is attached to the hand-over.
handoff.disclosureHint: A line telling customers they are talking to a bot.
handoff.keywordsHint: A message containing one of these goes straight to a person.

limits.title: Rate limits
limits.description: Protect the workspace from floods and runaway chats.
limits.perConversationHint: After this the customer is asked to start a new chat.
limits.perChannelHint: Customer messages the bot may answer per day on each channel.

validation.orderTime: The end must be after the start.

defaultBot.title: Default bot
defaultBot.description: The starting point every workspace inherits. A workspace keeps following it until it customises a setting.
defaultBot.inheritBody: Changes here reach workspaces that have not customised the same setting. Autopilot stays off until each workspace turns it on.

control.title: Bot control
control.description: Stop the bot everywhere in one click, or manage Autopilot workspace by workspace.
control.globalOnBody: Autopilot answers wherever it is switched on and has public documents.
control.globalOffBody: No workspace answers automatically. Copilot drafts for operators keep working.
control.confirmStopTitle: Stop the bot in every workspace?
control.confirmStopBody: Autopilot stops answering customers immediately. You can resume it at any time.
control.confirmResumeBody: Autopilot answers again in workspaces where it is switched on.
